Depth-Gated Attention for Training-Free Open-Vocabulary Segmentation

Abstract
We study how monocular depth can modulate the attention of CLIP.

4.2 Ablation
Adding the depth gate improves mIoU from 40.87 to 42.31 on ADE20K, while a spatial-only
prior already reaches 41.95, which suggests that most of the gain comes from locality.
Recognition accuracy is unchanged (80.02 vs. 80.00) when depth fea-
tures are added to the classifier.

Table 3: Results on SUIM. Our method obtains 58.0 mIoU.
